description: FREE: ready-to-sign purchase transaction for ONE DeFi cover. Returns buyCoverParams + poolAllocationRequests for the Nexus Mutual CoverBroker contract on Ethereum mainnet, a transparently disclosed broker commission (identical on every product, no influence on scores) and mandatory compliance notices (cover wording, restricted countries, membership required for claims) that MUST be shown to your principal before buying. This tool does NOT execute the purchase: sign and submit the transaction from the buyer wallet yourself (ETH payment = send maxPremiumInAsset as msg.value; ERC20 payment = approve CoverBroker first). Cover Raccoon never takes custody.

amount.description: Cover amount in smallest units of the cover asset (e.g. wei for ETH).

owner.description: Buyer wallet address (receives the cover NFT and pays the premium).
